I'm a new member of Frontia, having joined three days ago, and I've been enjoying it so far and with minimal issues. I just realized that there are notifications and going through them, I discovered the free model I've been using has been promotional only and that its promotion will expire soon, I think it's a terrible marketing strategy to lock all models behind needing stars. Especially for people like me who go through them a lot, so my thoughts are that Spark should remain free permanently, but have the better models require sparks and thus keep a steady income for the app.

Keeping Spark free also doubles as a trial run for the app and if users wish to use a better model, they can pay for it.

It's either keep Spark free or add in a monthly subscription that gives out stars for free

Hi, and welcome to Frontia! We're so happy you've been enjoying it these first few days:)

As you saw in the notice, Spark is currently free as a special event until November 14. We completely understand wanting to keep playing as much as you do now without worrying about Stars.

With your feedback in mind, we'll look into extending the event, as well as other ways and events that let you earn and use Stars more comfortably.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts so honestly, and we hope you keep having fun!!! (수정됨)
